titles.title: He Does It Better Than His Older Brother
Làm Tốt Hơn Cả Anh Trai

description:
During a family trip at a secluded pension, Eunchae sneaks into the room of Seunghyun, her long-time crush, to steal a bold kiss. However, the man who responds fiercely in the pitch black is not Seunghyun, but her arch-nemesis, Kang Taeyun! 

'Why? Are you upset it’s not him? Don’t worry. I’m better.' 

Following this fatal mistake, Taeyun seizes Eunchae's weakness and proposes a provocative one-month bet involving a 'leash.' 

Will Eunchae be able to win this dangerous game and reclaim her pride, or is she walking straight into a trap he meticulously designed?
